Before you come

Three small things that make an appointment go better.

  • Bring the person who will wear it, if you can — sizing by proxy is guesswork.
  • Bring any old gold you want valued. We weigh and test it in front of you, free.
  • Tell us your budget honestly. It is the fastest way to see the right tray.

If you cannot visit

We can still help from a distance.

  • Send a photograph or sketch on WhatsApp and we will quote it in writing.
  • Certified stones come with their papers, which we can share before you commit.
  • Finished pieces are delivered insured, or held at the showroom for collection.
